name: Veridu
tagline: Verify the code Cline just wrote before you commit it
description: AI code verification before commit. Cline sends the diff and the changed files to Veridu with verify_change; independent reviewers check the AI-generated change and return pass, review or block, with findings that give the file, line, severity and evidence. Cline fixes the findings that hold up and checks again: follow-ups say which findings persist and which a fix introduced. Also reviews GitHub pull requests. Sign in with OAuth; the free plan includes up to 20 reviews a month.
